@@U02348@@
That render him able To sit down at table.

@@U02350@@
(Oblivious.)

@@U02351@@
If nothing unpleasant gets in my way, I’m bound to have a jolly day! Look what I’ve brought you here without measure, Songs to delight you, and holiday leisure! And that’s why I drink now! Drink-adrink-drink! Clink glasses now, boys! Clinkety-clink! You boys back there! Come, join in our fun! When glasses clink, what’s done is done! My wife she jeered when she saw my clothes, “You look like a clown!” she said, and rose, And said she thinks I look like a joke, And for all she cares I can lay down and croak! But I drink for all that! Drink-adrink-drink! Clink glasses now, boys! Clinkety-clink! You boys are jokes, too! So join in the fun! Clink your glasses, and done is done! Never tell me I’ve lost my way! Por I know where I am, and I am where I say. And I know where I am I will get my fill, Credit lacking, I'll get credit still. So I'll keep on drinking! Drink-adrink-drink! Come on, boys! Now! Clinkety-clink! To each his own, and join in the fun! Clink your glasses, you've not yet done! I take my pleasure where I can, I do as well as any man; And if I can no longer stand, I'll lay me down and feel so grand.

@@U02353@@
And so, good brothers, drink-adrink-drink! Raise your glasses, clinkety-clink!

@@U02348@@
这使他能够坐在餐桌旁。

@@U02350@@
（没注意到。）

@@U02351@@
如果没有什么不愉快的事情妨碍我，我一定会度过愉快的一天！看我给你带来了什么，无量的欢歌，假期的休闲！这就是我现在喝酒的原因！喝喝喝！现在碰杯吧，孩子们！叮叮当当！你们那边的孩子们！来吧，加入我们的欢乐吧！当眼镜叮当响时，事情就完成了！我的妻子看到我的衣服嘲笑我：“你看起来像个小丑！”她说着，站了起来，并说她认为我看起来像个笑话，尽管她不在乎，但我可以躺下并呱呱叫！但我喝酒就是为了这一切！喝喝喝！现在碰杯吧，孩子们！叮叮当当！你们这些孩子也是个笑话！那就一起来享受乐趣吧！碰杯，大功告成！永远不要告诉我我迷路了！因为我知道我在哪里，而且我就在我所说的地方。我知道我在哪里我会得到满足，缺乏信用，我仍然会得到信用。那我就继续喝吧！喝喝喝！加油，孩子们！现在！叮叮当当！各尽所能，一起享受乐趣吧！碰杯吧，你还没说完呢！我尽可能地享受快乐，我和任何人一样；如果我再也站不起来了，我就会躺下来，感觉自己很伟大。

@@U02353@@
所以，好兄弟，喝喝喝！举起你的眼镜，叮叮当当！
